The '''Lover Gods''' were a pair of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] deities comprised of [[Yun-Q'aah]] and [[Yun-Txiin]]. Having a relationship outside one's caste was forbidden in Yuuzhan Vong society, and disobeying automatically led to sacrifice to the Lover Gods. Their priests were known as [[Apostle]]s of the [[Undying Flame]].
